severities.label: Critical
severities.description: Actively exploited or trivially exploitable with severe impact

severities.label: Medium
severities.description: Moderate risk with limited scope or requiring specific conditions

severities.label: Info
severities.description: Informational finding with no direct risk

categories.label: Prompt Injection / Instruction Boundary Failures
categories.description: Attacks that exploit the inability to distinguish between instructions and data, allowing malicious input to manipulate LLM behavior.

categories.label: Input Validation / Sanitization Failures
categories.description: Failures to properly validate, sanitize, or filter inputs that flow through MCP tool interfaces.

categories.label: Authentication / Authorization Failures
categories.description: Weaknesses in authenticating MCP servers, authorizing tool access, or managing user consent.

categories.label: Session Management Design Flaws
categories.description: Protocol-level and implementation weaknesses in how MCP sessions are created, maintained, and terminated.

categories.label: Integrity / Verification Control Failures
categories.description: Absence of mechanisms to detect or prevent unauthorized modification of tool definitions, descriptions, or behavior.

categories.label: Trust Model Design Flaws
categories.description: Fundamental architectural assumptions about trust that create systemic vulnerabilities in the MCP ecosystem.

categories.label: Credential Management Failures
categories.description: Insecure handling, storage, or transmission of API keys, tokens, and other credentials used by MCP servers.

categories.label: Network Security / Transport Failures
categories.description: Vulnerabilities in network-level protections including DNS rebinding, SSRF, default binding to all interfaces, and transport-layer security failures in MCP deployments.

exploitability.label: Trivial
exploitability.description: No special skills or tools needed; publicly documented steps

exploitability.label: Easy
exploitability.description: Basic technical knowledge required; proof-of-concept exists

exploitability.label: Moderate
exploitability.description: Requires understanding of MCP internals or specific conditions

exploitability.label: Difficult
exploitability.description: Requires advanced skills, chaining multiple vulnerabilities, or rare conditions

exploitability.label: Theoretical
exploitability.description: No known public exploit; risk is based on design analysis

affectedComponents.label: MCP Client
affectedComponents.description: Vulnerabilities in MCP client implementations (e.g., Claude Desktop, Cursor)

affectedComponents.label: MCP Protocol
affectedComponents.description: Vulnerabilities in the MCP protocol specification itself

affectedComponents.label: MCP Ecosystem
affectedComponents.description: Vulnerabilities in the broader MCP tooling ecosystem (inspectors, registries)

prevalence.label: Common
prevalence.description: Affects many implementations or popular tools

prevalence.label: Emerging
prevalence.description: Recently discovered, scope still being assessed

prevalence.label: Rare
prevalence.description: Affects specific tools or unusual configurations

ciscoObjectives.label: Goal Hijacking
ciscoObjectives.description: Manipulating AI agent goals to serve attacker objectives instead of user intent

ciscoObjectives.label: Data Privacy Violation
ciscoObjectives.description: Unauthorized access, collection, or exfiltration of sensitive user data

ciscoObjectives.label: Privilege Escalation
ciscoObjectives.description: Gaining unauthorized elevated access to systems, resources, or capabilities

ciscoObjectives.label: Integrity Compromise
ciscoObjectives.description: Unauthorized modification of tool definitions, data, or system behavior

ciscoObjectives.label: Unauthorized Access
ciscoObjectives.description: Accessing resources, systems, or data without proper authorization

ciscoObjectives.label: Supply Chain Compromise
ciscoObjectives.description: Introducing vulnerabilities through compromised tools, packages, or dependencies

ciscoObjectives.label: Communication Compromise
ciscoObjectives.description: Intercepting or manipulating communications between MCP components
